clips.text: The tender seed breaks through the hardest of rocks!
Because no matter how strong and powerful the rock, it is dead, and because it is dead it has no will.
The seed is tender, it is weak, but alive!
Remember, where there is will there is life and where there is no will there is no life.
The seed's will becomes its power. and with this power its tiny roots sprout, enter the rock and spread out, until one day they break the rock.
The living force within has never been defeated by the dead obstacles without - and never will be.
